documents.title: Intimation Of Grant Of Options Under OFSS Stock Plan 2014
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Notice of Postal Ballot
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment of ESOP / ESPS
Intimation Of Grant Of Options Under OFSS Stock Plan 2014

analysis.summary: Oracle Financial Services Software Limited reported consolidated revenues of 76.7 billion rupees, representing a 12 percent increase over the previous financial year, and net income of 26.4 billion rupees, reflecting an 11 percent increase year-on-year. The Board of Directors approved two interim dividends totaling 400 rupees per share for FY 2025-26. The company accelerated its AI-led innovation agenda, advancing intelligent automation across banking and insurance workflows, modernizing its cloud-ready product portfolio, and expanding cloud services. Furthermore, the company maintained an operating margin of 44 percent, reflecting a consistent focus on execution and operational efficiency. Oracle Financial Services Software Limited reported consolidated revenues of 68.5 billion for FY2025, representing a 7% increase over the previous financial year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the business landscape was shaped by dynamic global developments, evolving geo-political conditions, and accelerating technology trends during the financial year.
demand_outlook.quote: During the financial year, the business landscape was shaped by dynamic global developments, evolving geo-political conditions, and accelerating technology trends, creating a market environment that rewarded resilience and innovation.

demand_outlook.claim: The Chairperson noted that the business landscape was driven by global uncertainties, geopolitical challenges, and shifting technology trends leading to demand challenges in the industry.
demand_outlook.quote: During the financial year, the business landscape continued to be driven by global uncertainties, geo-political challenges and shifting technology trends - all leading to demand challenges in the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that License & Cloud revenues grew 13% over financial year 2023-24, driven by an increasing demand for cloud-native banking solutions.
demand_outlook.quote: Driven by an increasing demand for our cloud-native banking solutions, our License & Cloud revenues grew 13% over financial year 2023-24.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that banks are under intense pressure to deliver digital delight at scale while maintaining regulatory compliance and low costs.
demand_outlook.quote: With an increasingly tech savvy customer base which is spoilt for choice, banks are under intense pressure to deliver “digital delight” at scale with complete compliance to regulations and at the lowest possible cost.

demand_outlook.claim: Banks are increasingly looking for solutions on new architecture adaptable to rapid change and available on the cloud.
demand_outlook.quote: Banks are increasingly looking at solutions delivered on a new architecture which is adaptable to rapid change and is available on the cloud.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its cloud services portfolio for the banking industry with the launch of several new cloud services.
capex_expansion.quote: This year, we significantly expanded our cloud services portfolio for the banking industry with the launch of Oracle Banking Retail Lending Servicing Cloud Service, Oracle Banking Collections Cloud Service, Oracle Banking Cash Management Cloud Service, Oracle Banking Supply Chain Management Cloud Service, and Oracle Banking Trade Finance Cloud Service.

margins_costs.claim: The net margin remained strong at 34 percent.
margins_costs.quote: Net income rose to ₹ 26.4 billion, reflecting an 11% increase year-on-year, while the net margin remained strong at 34%.

margins_costs.claim: The company maintained strong financial discipline, resulting in an operating margin of 44 percent.
margins_costs.quote: We also continued to maintain strong financial discipline, resulting in an operating margin of 44%, reflecting the Company's consistent focus on execution and operational efficiency.

margins_costs.claim: Operating margin for the financial year rose to 44% compared to 42% in the previous financial year.
margins_costs.quote: We continued to maintain a strong financial discipline while driving the growth, and our operating margin for the financial year rose to 44% as compared to 42% in the last financial year.

margins_costs.claim: The company maintained a track record of delivering consistent high profitability metrics among the best in the industry.
margins_costs.quote: We are proud that we have maintained a track record of delivering consistent high profitability metrics which are amongst the best in our industry.

orders_capacity.claim: The company signed multiple multi-million dollar deals with marquee customers worldwide.
orders_capacity.quote: Your Company signed a number of multi-million dollar deals with marquee customers across the world which are a testimony to the excellence of our products through continuing R&D, our track record of delivering high quality implementations, and providing reliable support.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved license wins of $137M in fiscal year 2024, which is the highest ever for the company and a 44% growth over the previous fiscal year.
orders_capacity.quote: The fiscal year 2024 saw license wins of $137M – highest ever for the Company, registering a 44% growth over last fiscal.

orders_capacity.claim: Leading global banks launched programs to revamp global payment technologies across over 50 countries using the company's IT solutions.
orders_capacity.quote: Leading global banks launched programs to revamp their global payment technologies across over 50 countries on our IT solutions.

orders_capacity.claim: The company won a landmark deal with The Navy Federal Credit Union, USA, to modernize retail systems on the Oracle Banking Cloud offering.
orders_capacity.quote: Your Company won a landmark deal with The Navy Federal Credit Union, USA to modernize their retail systems on our Oracle Banking Cloud offering.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved two interim dividends totaling 400 rupees per share for FY 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board approved two interim dividends totaling ₹ 400 per share for FY 2025-26.

capital_allocation.claim: The Company has not transferred any amount to the reserves during the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company has not transferred any amount to the reserves during the year under review.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved an interim dividend of 265 per share for the financial year 2024-25, which is 10.4% higher than the dividend paid in the last financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board was pleased to approve an interim dividend of ₹ 265 per share for the financial year 2024-25, 10.4% higher than the dividend paid in the last financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board declared an interim dividend of ₹ 240 per share for the financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: On the strength of the performance, the Board was pleased to declare an interim dividend of ₹ 240 per share for the financial year.

risks_headwinds.claim: The business landscape during the financial year continued to be driven by global uncertainties, geopolitical challenges, and shifting technology trends.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the financial year, the business landscape continued to be driven by global uncertainties, geo-political challenges and shifting technology trends - all leading to demand challenges in the industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Fiscal year 2024 faced uncertainties including geopolitical conflicts, economic slowdowns, bank failures in the western world, and technology shifts.
risks_headwinds.quote: Fiscal year 2024 was fraught with several uncertainties including continued and expanding geopolitical conflicts, economic slowdowns, highly visible failures of some banks in the western world, and tectonic technology shifts with increasing usage of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) and machine learning (ML).

management_commitments.claim: The Board of Directors declared the 1st interim dividend of 130 rupees per equity share and 2nd interim dividend of 270 rupees per equity share for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The Board of Directors of the Company ("the Board") declared 1st interim dividend of ₹ 130 per equity share and 2nd interim dividend of ₹ 270 per equity share of ₹ 5 each on October 17, 2025 and April 22, 2026, respectively, for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.

management_commitments.claim: The Board has not recommended any additional final dividend for the financial year 2025-26.
management_commitments.quote: The Board has not recommended any additional final dividend for the financial year 2025-26.

management_commitments.claim: The board declared an interim dividend of ₹ 240 per equity share for the financial year ended March 31, 2024.
management_commitments.quote: The Board of Directors of the Company declared an interim dividend of ₹ 240 per equity share of ₹ 5 each on April 24, 2024, for the financial year ended March 31, 2024.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
